scenarios.reasoning: Thorough, evidence-backed investigation with excellent external cross-verification of per-TFM assembly versions and correct root-cause identification. Main shortfall: it never actually read App.config's XML (unavailable in binlog) and its fix recommendation is somewhat cluttered, including a partly contradictory suggestion to keep/adjust the redirect.

Discovered per-TFM assembly versions in NuGet package (10.0.0.0 net8.0, 10.0.0.3 net462)
Found App.config binding redirect with newVersion=10.0.0.3
Traced AppConfigFile into RAR for all TFMs incl. net8.0
Explained RAR unification to 10.0.0.3 conflicting with 10.0.0.0
Proposed removing hardcoded redirect, letting AutoGenerateBindingRedirects handle net472
